# ProKit Studio Stack

## App stack

- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- PostgreSQL + Prisma
- Clerk (auth)
- Stripe (billing)
- Resend (optional email)

## Recommended starter stack (docs)

- Supabase for managed Postgres
- Vercel for hosting

This is an onboarding recommendation, not lock-in.
